$description: Descriptions for the semantic tokens, written once and used by every theme, by Figma and by code.
color.bg.canvas: Screen background, the base layer behind everything.
color.bg.surface: Cards, sheets and inputs that sit on the canvas.
color.bg.surface-raised: Popovers and overlays that sit above surfaces.
color.bg.sunken: Tracks, wells and quiet panels set into a surface.
color.bg.inverse: Rare high-contrast surfaces. Pair with text/inverse.
color.bg.feature: One highlighted card per screen, such as the recommended mode or the care prompt. Pair with text/on-feature.
color.border.subtle: Card edges and dividers. Decorative only, not for controls.
color.border.strong: Edges of controls that must be seen, such as unselected radios, fields and secondary buttons.
color.text.tertiary: Placeholders, hints and metadata. Still passes 4.5:1.
color.accent.default: The one interactive colour: primary buttons, selected states, the active tab and the range amount.
color.accent.subtle: Selected backgrounds and the active tab indicator.
color.accent.text: Links and tertiary buttons on canvas or surface.
color.accent.on: Text and icons on accent/default, hover and pressed.
color.status.good: In range and done. Use with words or an icon, never colour alone.
color.status.good-subtle: Background for good messages and badges.
color.status.attention: Gentle nudges, such as being below a range. Not an error.
color.status.attention-subtle: Background for attention messages and badges.
color.status.info: Explanations and neutral notes, including going over a range.
color.status.info-subtle: Background for info messages and badges.
color.status.error: Real input errors only. Never for eating more or less than planned.
color.mode.wellness-subtle: Background for the Wellness mode badge and icon tile.
color.mode.athlete-subtle: Background for the Athlete mode badge and icon tile.
color.macro.protein: Protein in bars and charts, always with a text label.
color.macro.carbs: Carbohydrates in bars and charts, always with a text label.
color.macro.fat: Fat in bars and charts, always with a text label.
color.macro.fibre: Fibre in bars and charts, always with a text label.
color.focus.ring: Keyboard focus ring, 2 px outside the control. Passes 3:1 on canvas and surface.
color.appearance.light-dot: Appearance picker, Calm light card dot: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.light-border: Appearance picker, Calm light card border: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.light-bg: Appearance picker, Calm light card bg: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.light-ring: Appearance picker, Calm light card ring: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.dark-dot: Appearance picker, Calm dark card dot: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.dark-border: Appearance picker, Calm dark card border: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.dark-bg: Appearance picker, Calm dark card bg: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.dark-ring: Appearance picker, Calm dark card ring: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.warm-dot: Appearance picker, Warm card dot: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.warm-border: Appearance picker, Warm card border: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.warm-bg: Appearance picker, Warm card bg: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
color.appearance.warm-ring: Appearance picker, Warm card ring: on in its own theme, off in the others. Only for the Theme option component.
